name: Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Bal Seva Yojana (Genearal)
_eligibility_text:
**Non-Institutional Children:** 1. Children under 18 who have lost both parents or one parent due to non-Covid reasons. 1. Adolescents 18-23 who lost both or one parent due to Covid or any reason, and are pursuing higher education after completing 12th grade. 1. Children of divorced/abandoned mothers. 1. Children whose parents/guardian are imprisoned. 1. Children rescued from child labor, begging, or prostitution. 1. Children of families involved in begging/prostitution. 1. An assistance will be provided to maximum two children of the family. 1. The annual income of the family of all the categories of children should be less than ₹3,00,000/- but the condition of income limit will not apply to those where both mother and father have died.
**Institutional Children:** 1. Under the age group of 0-18, previously lived in children's homes and reintegrated back into families or residing in child care institutions. 1. Support: Receives financial assistance and family/aftercare services for readjustment.
